name: Bibcite Authors
description: Adds three field formatters for the Bibcite contributor field that render author names last-name-first and optionally link them to matching Drupal user accounts.
project_description: Bibcite Authors is a small add-on for the Bibcite bibliography suite that provides field formatters for the bibcite_contributor field type. It lets a reference's author/contributor names be displayed last-name-first and, where a Contributor is associated with a Drupal user account (via a field_author reference on the user), rendered as a link to that user's profile. There is no configuration UI, no routes and no permissions of its own; you simply select one of its formatters on a reference entity's Manage Display page (or in a view).
